_meta.meaning: Matches of place identity across archived scrape sources. NOT independent verification of current cruising, lawful access, or recent activity.
matching: same city + country + exact distinctive name
distinctive same-country UK names where city is absent
_meta.confidence_note: Uncertain aliases/subareas only in review arrays. Source repeats and gap-fill are counted once per website.
_meta.file_ref_rule: refs.f is the original JSON file path; refs.i is 1-based index among records of that file, ordered by country/city then record (for scrape main), or top-level records (for gap and Squirt).
_meta.review_note: Via Brin vs Parcheggio Brin and general Hyde Park vs Rose Garden are geographic/subarea comparisons, not automatic same-place matches.
